title: Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan Terms: Ending a Plan before the Term Ends, Free Cancellation and Refunds
content:
## Terms

1. A Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan ends early when the tenant moves out or asks to end it before the term ends. Early termination is available where the plan allows the tenant to end it early, and the refund is computed on the plan's refund basis.
2. A cancellation is refunded in full only when it is made not later than the prepayment date plus the plan's free-cancellation days. Free-cancellation days are calendar days counted from the day after the prepayment date, and the last counted day is included.
3. After that window the refund is the prepayment less the standard monthly rent, without discount or free months, for each month already applied, less the plan's early termination fee, and never below zero; a partly used period is not refunded. A partly used period is refunded only where the plan provides for partial-month refunds.
4. The refund is paid by the plan's refund method within the plan's refund period.
5. A transfer keeps the plan where the plan carries over on a unit transfer, with any rent difference settled on the plan's transfer adjustment basis.

The free-cancellation days, the early termination fee, the refund method and period, and the transfer settings are set for each plan.

## The refund after the free-cancellation window, in words

The refund equals the prepayment received for the plan, less the plan's locked monthly rent — taken in full, without the plan discount — for every month already applied to the covered agreement (a free month already applied counts at the full locked rent too), less the early termination fee. If that comes to less than zero, the refund is zero. Months already applied are counted from the term start date up to and including the day the plan is ended.

## The free-cancellation window

- The clock starts on the prepayment date shown in the company's record of the plan; that day is not counted.
- Day 1 is the next calendar day; the last day of the window is the prepayment date plus the free-cancellation days, and a cancellation made on that last day is within the window.
- A cancellation made on any later day falls after the window and is refunded under term 3.

| Plan's free-cancellation days | Prepayment date | Last day of the window | Cancellation made | Refund (hypothetical dates) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 7 | 2 March | 9 March | 9 March | In full |
| 7 | 2 March | 9 March | 10 March | Under term 3 |
| 14 | 2 March | 16 March | 16 March | In full |
| 14 | 2 March | 16 March | 17 March | Under term 3 |

## Worked refunds (hypothetical plans and rents)

**Case 1.** A plan with a locked rent of $129.00 and a prepayment of $1,348.05 is ended after 4 months have been applied; the plan's early termination fee is $35.00.
- Months applied at the full locked rent: $129.00 multiplied by 4 is $516.00.
- Prepayment less that amount: $1,348.05 less $516.00 is $832.05.
- Less the fee: $832.05 less $35.00 is $797.05, which is the refund.

**Case 2.** A plan with a locked rent of $100.00 and a prepayment of $1,581.00 is ended after 16 months have been applied; the fee is $50.00.
- Months applied at the full locked rent: $100.00 multiplied by 16 is $1,600.00, more than the prepayment.
- The prepayment less $1,600.00 and less the $50.00 fee is below zero, so the refund is zero.

## Plan statuses in these terms

| From | To | When |
|---|---|---|
| Active | Ended early | The tenant ends the covered agreement or the plan before the term ends; the refund, if any, follows |
